mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_turn (session_id, seq, kind, status, model, usage_json, created_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{seq}, #{kind}, #{status}, #{model}, #{usageJson}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT usage_json FROM chat_turn WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND usage_json IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chat_turn WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
SELECT id, session_id, seq, kind, status, model, usage_json, created_at FROM chat_turn WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY id ASC
